item: RTL date probe skips mirrored flip-card backs and ignores wraps (row 161)
summary: The Home P1 reordered date was the walk reading the unflipped back face of a briefing card through rotateY(180deg); the probe now skips mirrored nodes and compares characters on one line only. App dates were already isolated by ooIsoDate and the raw-date ratchet; a ten-tab Arabic sweep found none bare.
